open_task_policy: Accept independently verified alternative constructions, counterexamples, and unexpected results. Explicit additional-hypothesis results are legitimate contributions but must not be relabeled as completion of the original scope. A short proof using applicable standard theorems is fully acceptable. Honest incompleteness is distinct from an invalid proof.
required_evidence: Starting only from the supplied set and two algebra equations, construct an actual topology and prove it is compact and Hausdorff.
Prove the exact ultrafilter convergence specification and uniqueness of the topology.
Construct the reverse operation from every compact Hausdorff topology and verify both algebra equations and both object round trips.
Prove that all algebra-compatible set maps are exactly all continuous maps for the constructed topologies, with the same identities and compositions.
Construct an actual profinite P and continuous surjection q from the reconstructed X such that every continuous map into every profinite target factors uniquely through q.

Identify the exact fibres of q and prove the necessary-and-sufficient injectivity criterion in terms of the original algebra operation and finite algebra observations; verify the full finite-observation kernel, not only one containment.
critical_errors: Presuppose a topology on X or use continuity of the input a before constructing and validating its topology.
Package compactness, Hausdorffness or the desired convergence as an input certificate.
Define purported closed sets or quotient topology but omit the topology/separation or closure-law proof.
Use the algebra associativity equation on the wrong ultrafilter level.
Prove existence of a chosen limit but not uniqueness, or prove a weaker convergence implication than required.
Identify morphisms only in one direction or assume the map is continuous when proving the algebra-to-topology direction.
Assume an arbitrary quotient by connected components is Hausdorff without using the reconstructed compact Hausdorff hypotheses.
Identify only one direction between common finite-observation fibres and the proposed quotient fibres.
Prove factorization for finite targets only and claim the stated universal property for all profinite targets without an argument.
Silently assume that the reconstructed topology is totally disconnected or that its finite observations separate points.
completion_policy: A complete topology/algebra correspondence and the additional universal profinite reflection, exact fibres and finite algebra observation injectivity criterion are required. The closed-kernel route, a closure-operator route, correctly applied Manes and profinite-reflection theorems, or any other complete route are accepted. Named theorems can give short valid solutions; no author proof route, fixed number of intermediate lemmas or mandatory extra examples is imposed.
